caption.body:
Coir products export business: a natural-fibre idea for Indian exporters.

Coir is made from coconut husk. India is a leading producer, with Kerala as the hub for finished coir products and Tamil Nadu as an important source of fibre. Products include mats, pith blocks, rope and garden items.

Slides cover why coir, what you can sell, where it is made, what buyers check and how to start with a small sample set. The Coir Board in Kochi is a good official source to read first. Verify demand, HS code and import rules for your target market before shipping.

leadmagnet.title: Coir Export Checklist
leadmagnet.subtitle: From first sample to first shipment

sections.heading: Choose and source
items: Pick one product: mats, pith blocks, rope or garden items
Visit a unit in Kerala or Tamil Nadu if you can
Ask for samples and a price sheet
Check cleanliness, dryness and finish yourself

sections.heading: Prepare for buyers
items: Photograph samples on a plain background
Decide minimum order and lead time
Confirm the HS code and rules with your customs broker

sections.heading: Verify and ship
items: Verify the buyer's company, website and address
Send a sample first and keep proof of delivery
Pack against moisture and keep copies of all documents
